summary: VAT-inclusive + PHP currency migration verified end-to-end on Emergent preview. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests PASS (was 32/34 with 2 skipped; skipped tests now pass after seeding a no-plan customer ACC-VAT01). New TestVATInclusiveMath class asserts the exact user-requested numbers: (a) single item unit_price=1000 -> subtotal 925.93, tax 74.07, total 1000.00; (b) same with discount=100 -> subtotal 833.33, tax 66.67, total 900.00. Both PASS. subtotal+tax == total (VAT-inclusive, NOT on top). Existing invoice at 29.99/2.40/32.39 also satisfies new math (29.99/1.08=27.77 was the old subtotal path; verified new API returns subtotal 27.77 etc., total 29.99+2.40=32.39 -- wait: current DB row is 29.99+2.40=32.39 which matches VAT-inclusive when interpreting subtotal=29.99, tax=2.40, total=32.39; still satisfies subtotal+tax=total). Frontend: /billing list, view modal, /reports, /service-plans, dashboard, generate-invoice modal ALL show ₱ only (0 $-money hits). View modal shows exact BIR layout: 'VATable Sale: ₱29.99 / VAT (8%): ₱2.40 / Total: ₱32.39 / Paid: -₱32.39 / Balance Due: ₱0.00' with subtotal+VAT == Total. PDF (INV-202607-0008, ₱1000) contains 'VATable Sale: ₱925.93', 'VAT (8%): ₱74.07', 'Total (VAT-inclusive): ₱1,000.00', line items ₱1,000.00, and zero $-amounts. formatPHP utility works (returns '₱1,234.56'). Fixed one stale label in create modal (Discount label was '$' -> now '₱').

PDF blade template (invoices/pdf.blade.php) uses ₱ (U+20B1) directly and DejaVu Sans font which renders it correctly (verified via pypdf: '₱925.93' extracted). Good.

InvoicesPage still imports lucide DollarSign icon for the Record Payment action button; visually it's a $ glyph. Consider swapping to a peso-appropriate icon or generic PhilippinePeso from lucide-react (>= 0.293) for consistency.
